accepted literal true, reasons empty, executed_tests equals every staged fixture count; actual production fixture execution, PIT/evidence checks, exact v3→v4/v2→v3 progression, same registered callable IDs, concept consistency and stable semantic/behavior duplicate checks.

validator_hash_policy: Use actual SlowLoop._technical_validator_hash policy or an exactly documented equivalent: policy signal-technical-admission-v1, validator source SHA, executor source SHA, actual deterministic contracts, forbidden identity aliases, runner identity, public registration and model contract hash. Use truthful unknown lineage where needed; retain known GPRE development/induction exposure and source-input hash, and exclude exposed cases from later independent effect claims. atomic_recovery: Before any stable edit, freeze exact input Registry version/hash/ordered refs and all passing candidate/admission identities.
A prepared transition blocks ordinary Registry reads. Recovery can reconcile only that exact prepared identity; changed candidates/evaluations/extra stable mutations reject.
Copy exact admission.json and manifest admission_keys before output freeze. Read back stable spec/skill/tests/candidate hash/admission key, output version/hash and research status.
Idempotent exact transition replay may verify/reconcile; never run normal promotion twice under a new identity as a substitute for recovery.

Existing real-source audit establishes one GM numeric measurement and one acceleration missing-Q4 abstention; it does not establish real-source numeric acceleration success.
